{{Quote|In a move that stunned political observers, the Dentaal Independence Party, with full public support, ousted the Imperial administration of Governor Taliff and took direct control of the Dentaalian government it had vacated only nine months earlier.|[[Imperial HoloVision]]|<ref name="AJ5">{{JournalCite|5|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>}}
'''Taliff''' was the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of [[Dentaal/Legends|Dentaal]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. After he eliminated the [[Dentaalian House]], its members formed the [[Dentaal Independence Party]] and [[Dentaal Uprising|overthrew]] him in a bloodless coup. In retaliation, [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]] wiped out Dentaal's population with the [[Candorian plague/Legends|Candorian plague]].
